repos_data.description: Consequence firewall for machine actions. EMILIA Gate verifies exact authority before money, code, permissions, infrastructure, or regulated state changes; the open protocol makes the evidence independently verifiable.
Airtight math tools an AI uses over MCP — 3.7M-theorem search, PSLQ constant ID, OEIS, real Lean kernel checks, applicability checklists. No LLM inside, no API key.
Lingua Universale -- a verification language for AI agent protocols. Like mypy for multi-agent communication. 3696 tests, zero deps.
Deterministic safety layer for AI agents. Z3-verified policy enforcement.
A programming language designed for AI agents. No parser, no syntax — agents produce AST directly as JSON. Statically typed, effect-tracked, contract-verified, compiled to WASM via MCP.
